Remote Code Execution in Network Stack
object.content: A critical remote code execution vulnerability was discovered in the network stack component. An attacker can exploit this issue to execute arbitrary code with elevated privileges.

object.name: Question from Finder
object.content: Is there a workaround available while the patch is being developed?

object.name: C1 Response
object.content: Yes, disabling the affected module is an effective interim workaround.

object.name: C2 Update
object.content: We have confirmed that C2 and Vendor are engaged. Target disclosure in 30 days.

object.name: Vendor Status Update
object.content: Vendor can confirm the issue affects our component. We will align our fix timeline with the 30-day target.
